name: @561-group/farstone
description: Farstone — a small New-England harbor MUD built on the tab EAVT world-engine (@561-group/tab) and the FizzOS MUD driver (@561-group/fizzos), the way ruinfold is a game on tab. The world IS its append-only EAVT trace, folded (settled) every tick; a contested permit ages under its own clock to ⊤ (within-window AND overdue, a held situation). Several authored worlds ship: farstone (the seed island), farstone-harbor (the quarrel-on-the-quay deep-systems world the bin serves), farstone-tale (the designed off-season demo), and farstone-wild (a generated world).
